fusions.name: Shouldered Thrust
fusions.desc: A thrust that deals 7 damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Holds 5 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Lance Run
fusions.desc: You rush up to 7 tiles to the target and thrust, dealing 12 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full range.

fusions.name: Second Wind
fusions.desc: Restores 4 stamina a second for 8 seconds. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4s after you use it.

fusions.name: Mounted Guard
fusions.desc: A bonded heidel fights beside you, striking enemies within 3 tiles for 5 damage every 1.8 seconds and slowing each by 15% for 2 seconds. You can ride it.
